comparison.objective: Fold a limp humanoid forward past its balance point so its back hatch faces up; candidate commissions a compact damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Articulated whole-body folding and balance management differ from recessed-tool alignment, collar adjustment, counterholding, and torque-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Humanoid must finish with hatch facing up between rocks; the record omits pose, contact, stability, limb-safety, and damage thresholds. Candidate uses quantified impact and lock-drift checks.
comparison.reason: The task tests articulated-body manipulation rather than mechanical calibration.
